title: Shortest Path in an Unweighted Graph (BFS)
summary: Find the fewest edges from a start vertex to every other vertex. Breadth-first search reaches vertices in order of distance, so the first route found is a shortest one.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Edges
inputs.hint: Edges as pairs of vertex numbers, for example 0, 1, 1, 2 means the edges 0–1 and 1–2. Vertex numbers start at 0.

inputs.name: vertices
inputs.label: Number of vertices
inputs.hint: From 1 to 8. Vertices are numbered 0 up to one less than this number.

inputs.name: start
inputs.label: Start vertex
inputs.hint: Where the search begins: a vertex number from 0 up to vertices − 1.

anchors.label: Store the edges in an adjacency matrix
